summary: London, UK, graphic designer, educated at Royal College of Art, strong interest in typography and web design, advocates for open-source software, critical of capitalism and corporate practices, engaged in discussions about social justice and healthcare, has a long-term partner, enjoys pottery, has experience in teaching and mentoring, involved in community service, values quiet and peace, prefers music-free environments for concentration, has a background in music (piano), interested in human psychology and behavioral studies, critical of mainstream media and advertising practices.
